transcript:
HEADER: 2026-03-30 09:00 PDT | Duration: 45 mins | Attendees: Ava Thompson, Diego Ruiz, Lena Park (Redwood); Maya Chen, Raj Patel, Elena Gomez, Tom Baker (Internal)

SUMMARY: quick admin sync to close out invoices, check SOC2 artifacts for renewal, and confirm network peering diagram for private deploy tests.

[00:00] Ava: okay good morning everyone, thanks for jumping on. quick agenda — billing reconciliation, SOC two docs, and VPC peering follow up. maya, do you want to kick off on invoices?
[00:18] Maya: yeah uh sure, thanks. so finance flagged a couple of vendor line items from feb-march that didn't match the usage report, so raj and i dug in. looks like two charges were billed under the old sku mapping — it's basically a mapping mismatch between the billing export and the usage csv.
[00:34] Raj: and to add, the credits we expected for the committed reserved capacity didn’t apply because the commit id was missing from the invoice metadata; it's probably an ingestion bug from the billing ETL.
[00:50] Diego: hmm could that be the export from the legacy billing service? we switched the connector in feb, maybe the metadata fields changed.
[01:05] Maya: yeah could be. i'll send the vendor invoice spreadsheet to raj today, and he can reconcile with the usage report.
[01:16] Ava: perfect. raj, if you can flag anything that impacts cash ops this month — i think the run is tuesday next week?
[01:25] Raj: yep payroll/invoice run tuesday, so if we need to adjust accruals let us know by monday end of day.
[01:33] Elena: switching to security, quick note — SOC 2 attestation renewal is coming up. we've got a draft, but we still need the network architecture diagram for the private deployment tests to include in the scope.
[01:45] Lena: i can work with maya on the VPC peering diagram; there were a couple of questions about the peering CIDRs and route tables.
[01:55] Maya: i'll pull the diagram from the infra repo — though heads up the file name in the repo is old, the CI pipeline sometimes renames artifacts so it might show up as vpc-diagram-final-2 or similar, sorry about that.
[02:08] Ava: no worries, just add a readme note. also legal needs confirmation on the data retention clause before we sign the amendment — tom can you confirm?
[02:16] Tom: yeah i'll review the clause, we prefer 12 months for logs, but if ops want 18 months we can discuss. i'll confirm by next friday.
[02:27] Elena: for KMS, one ask — we need proof of key rotation cadence and whether HSM-backed keys are used for production tokens. the current doc has K-M-S H-S-M spelled out but missing rotation dates.
[02:42] Diego: noted — our platform ops stack uses the HSM provider for master keys, and we rotate service keys every 90 days, master key rotation is on a two-year cadance but we can provide the audit logs. 
[02:57] Elena: audit logs would be great. also, can you confirm where audit logs are stored and retention? some of the SOC 2 reviewers asked about the log pipeline, whether logs go to long-term S3 or a third-party logging provider.
[03:12] Diego: logs are sent to our central logging cluster and also archived to s3 for 18 months by default; there was a miscommunication earlier where someone thought it was 12 — i'll double check.
[03:25] Raj: back to billing, one more piece — the committed capacity credits, if they don't apply automatically we'll need to manually apply credits this cycle. that impacts cash flow.
[03:36] Ava: okay we'll treat that as high priority — diego can check the ETL mapping and maya/raj will prepare the adjustments.
[03:45] Maya: sounds good. also quick note, for the private deploy test next week we need to confirm IP allowlists and a short-lived service account for the test harness.
[03:56] Lena: i can create the short-lived service account, but we need approval from legal for the scope of access.
[04:04] Tom: agree, keep the scope minimal. legal will approve if it's just read-only to the test resources.
[04:12] Ava: great. scheduling — lena will propose times for a quarterly access review, and maya will send the VPC diagram. diego will check the billing ETL. tom will confirm retention language. raj will reconcile invoices.
[04:28] Maya: one small transcription note — the private deployment runner referenced the 'K-V cash' earlier in the doc, i think you mean KV cache, typos aplenty in the exports.
[04:38] Diego: yeah classic transcription issues, those auto transcripts always do that.
[04:44] Elena: any blockers on SOC2 evidence collection?
[04:48] Ava: not yet, just the network diagram and rotation dates. once we have those, we'll upload to the auditor portal.
[04:57] Tom: i'll also double-check the contract addendum language for data residency and retention.
[05:02] Ava: okay let's recap and close out. next steps are in the action items, i'll follow up with a short email and attach the security pack once uploaded. thanks everyone.
[05:13] (meeting ends)
